teaching_language: Language of the chosen participating master's programme (set by the host university)

milestones.label: Window 1 applications open for the 2027 call
milestones.source_text: The World Bank's JJ/WBGSP page (official) lists Window 1 as 18 January to 26 February 2027; which window applies depends on the programme.

milestones.label: Application deadline, Window 1
milestones.source_text: Official World Bank page: Window 1 closes on 26 February 2027.

milestones.label: Window 2 applications open for the 2027 call
milestones.source_text: Official World Bank page: Window 2 runs 29 March to 21 May 2027, for the programmes assigned to that window.

milestones.label: Application deadline, Window 2
milestones.source_text: Official World Bank page: Window 2 closes on 21 May 2027. The page gives no result date, only that winners are told soon after the Steering Committee approves them.
